name: StudioFlowIQ Staff
subtitle: Your studio team, in flow
description: A dedicated workspace for studio owners, managers, coaches and front desk staff. Manage assigned schedules and rosters, check members in, access authorized studio operations and keep support correspondence in one place. Features depend on your studio-assigned role. An internet connection is required.
reviewNotes: Invitation-only access. Supply dedicated review accounts and a sample studio. Purchases cover in-person studio services/retail; no software subscription purchase is exposed in the native client. Do not use live cards for review tests.
